_comment: DRAFT — UNREVIEWED, same status as tamil_strings_DRAFT.json (see that file's own _comment; nothing here changes that). This is the audio-composition plan, not new wording: every fixed segment's text is a direct split of the already-drafted sentence in tamil_strings_DRAFT.json, done to make it stitchable. Numbers are handled Indian-Railways-style: each whole number in [number_range] is its own pre-recorded word (Tamil number pronunciation isn't simple digit concatenation - '42' is one word, not 'four' 'two' - so ElevenLabs synthesizes each full number once, correctly, rather than this project trying to hand-compose Tamil numeral grammar). At playback, a key with more than one segment is not one audio file - it's an ordered list played back-to-back, the same way a railway PA system plays 'train number' + [pre-recorded number] + 'is running late by' + [pre-recorded number] + 'hours' as separate clips in sequence, never as one spliced file.
